content_metadata.description: Follow William, an experienced hunter, as he embarks on a challenging elk hunting trip in the snowy landscapes of Arizona. As he navigates through the wilderness, he faces the ups and downs of the hunt, from the excitement of the journey to the frustration of unfruitful searches. Alongside his occasional companion JJ, William encounters signs of wildlife and reflects on the essence of persistence in the wild.

Today a professional elk hunting guide who has successfully guided 128 elk harvests is out on the Arizona strip with me chasing this impossible herd of elk. 

We're cutting tracks in fresh snow, hiking, glassing, and learning what it takes to succeed in one of the lowest success hunts that the west has to offer. 

If you're new to the channel, I've been at this for months, and we're going to keep at it.
